summary: Iteration 2 backend-only retest of the four defects from iteration_1.json. All four are FIXED and verified: (1) image_url is now returned by /api/public/wall/{ws_slug} and /api/public/widget/{wid} (verified end-to-end: image-only submit on a Free-plan workspace -> approve -> both public payloads carry the exact image_url, no _id leakage); (2) /api/public/collection/{slug} now gates allow_video by workspace plan (free -> false even when the collection has allow_video=true; pro and business -> true; collection-level allow_video=false still wins on paid plans); (3) GET /api/health returns {"status":"ok"} 200 and the legacy root /health still works; (4) require_admin and public_user fail closed - with ADMIN_EMAIL commented out of backend/.env and the backend restarted, a freshly registered admin@testify.com user got is_admin=false in the register/login and /api/auth/me payloads and 403 on both GET and PUT /api/admin/settings. Env file and backend were restored afterwards (verified ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@testify.day, /api/health 200, admin login OK). Full regression: 33/33 tests pass (26 previous incl. the formerly-failing image_url test + 7 new) plus 2 fail-closed tests = 35/35 green. Stripe/Google untested (unconfigured), per request.

minor.issue: STILL OPEN from iteration 1 (not part of this iteration's scope): plans_override is List[Dict[str, Any]] in models.py:190 with no per-field validation, so price_monthly can be stored as an arbitrary string and is echoed verbatim by GET /api/plans. Recommend a typed PlanOverride model.

STILL OPEN: in-process rate limiter (defaultdict, 5 calls/300s per client IP) counts rejected calls and is not shared across workers/replicas. QA has to restart the backend to clear it. Move to Mongo/Redis-backed counters before scaling out.

action_items: Optional (carry-over, non-blocking): add a typed PlanOverride pydantic model for plans_override entries
Optional (carry-over, non-blocking): move the submit rate limiter out of process memory
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1361 lines - still above the 700-line guideline; split into routers (auth, collections, testimonials, widgets, admin, payments, public)
/health and /api/health are two separate handlers returning the same literal - fine, but consider one handler registered on both paths

public_user() and require_admin() now derive admin from os.environ ADMIN_EMAIL at call time (good: fail-closed, no hardcoded fallback). Note seed_admin() silently no-ops when ADMIN_EMAIL is unset and only logs at error level - document that a missing ADMIN_EMAIL means no admin at all

_public_testimonial remains the single serializer for public payloads; keep adding every new media field there (image_url regression is now covered by tests in test_iteration2_fixes.py and test_plan_gating.py)

success_rate.backend: 100% (35/35 tests: 33 in the main run + 2 fail-closed)

seed_data_creation: Registered throwaway users test_it2free_*/test_it2pro_*@example.com (TestPass123!) with published collections, one image testimonial, one grid widget; one pro/business workspace promoted via db.workspaces.update_one; a temporary admin@testify.com user for the fail-closed test. All removed - verified 0 residual test_ users, admin@testify.com deleted, platform_settings back to defaults.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md now exists and is accurate: admin admin@testify.day / AdminTest123!; test users registered on the fly as test_*@example.com / TestPass123!
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend at http://localhost:8001 under supervisor; there is still no /app/frontend/.env with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, so frontend testing needs that first (frontend service was FATAL in iteration 1). Tests: conftest.py (BASE_URL/api, admin_token, free_user, mongo, reset_rate_limit which restarts the backend to clear the in-memory submit rate limit), backend_test.py, test_plan_gating.py, test_iteration2_fixes.py (health, allow_video plan gating, image_url in wall+widget). test_admin_failclosed.py MUST be run on its own (it rewrites /app/backend/.env to drop ADMIN_EMAIL, restarts the backend, then restores both) - do not run it in the same session as admin_token-dependent tests. Run with `-p no:randomly` for stable ordering. Still unverified: Stripe /api/payments/* (no STRIPE_SECRET_KEY), Google OAuth (no GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID), S3 uploads (no S3_BUCKET_NAME - storage init warns and is skipped, so real file upload endpoints were not exercised; image_url tests used external URLs).
rca_of_the_issue: All four iteration-1 root causes are addressed in code and confirmed by tests: image_url added to _public_testimonial (server.py ~951); _public_collection (~854) computes allow_video = col.allow_video AND _is_unlimited(ws.plan); a duplicate @app.get('/api/health') route added (server.py 1339) so the ingress /api prefix resolves; public_user (82) and require_admin (89) read ADMIN_EMAIL and treat an empty value as 'no admin exists' instead of falling back to admin@testify.com.
